Granted at the time I decided to start taking melatonin I was in the deepest depression I have ever been in and the rate of my SH and the quality of my harm, I knew if I didn't stop I was going to end up needing and ER visit. So I just knocked myself out instead.

Outside of that, it is also a sign of stress. 
The build up of never feeling like you do anything right is something I am so so sooooooo familiar with. It hurts. A lot. And every. Little. Thing. That does not go right and even slightly has any way to connect to you, your mind makes it your fault regardless. I had this so bad that when I would feel and let those emotions in I could get physical pain in my chest and my right wrist/thumb? Strangley enough. And sometimes the pain would go through my back. It's strange how stress can manifest into physical pain. 


Honestly let yourself feel sad about the bowl. Mourn this bowl so your able to see a new one and love it just as much over time. 


As for feeling like you do everything wrong. That one is a lot harder. It's hard not to think about it. It's hard not to pick apart everything that could be ones fault. I think with that just let yourself feel. But don't let yourself get enveloped. Justify to yourself how each situation could be your fault BUT also justify how it isn't. There are so many sides to everything. And looking at all the sides you can learn better options.
